title: The history of the universe as a cone
author: A. David Weigel, *INTUITIVE*® Planetarium

frame.x: time: Big Bang at -L/2, today at +L/2
frame.twoScales: Every layer has story positions (time stretched so each era shows) and true positions (time linear, 1 ly = 1 billion years; width = real expansion a(t)). Morph = lerp(story, true, w) on positions, colors and sizes.

grid.note: Each object is one or more line strips (polylineStarts are offsets inside the object). Ribs run apex to mouth in equal axis steps (4001 vertices: a reveal advances whole vertices, so keep the count high). Rings: s = position along the cone 0..1; strong = era boundary (brighter, wider).
grid.ribS: rib vertex i is at s = i / (count - 1)

dots.note: Hot plasma (first third, white to amber), first stars and galaxies (blue-white). Rows are in REVEAL order: on the dome drawRange percent = dots_frac[] of the step. size multiplies the layer dot size (dome dotScale 0.5).

ray.note: Light from a galaxy at z about 13 to the telescope; its wavelength is drawn in proportion to the scale factor a(t), colored violet to red. Revealed in file order (source to telescope) over 9 s; the dome also draws a wider glow copy (LineGlow texture, width 4).

years.note: One white ring per billion years (1 to 13); shown only for the true-scale morph, where they slide from bunched to even spacing.

bubbles.note: 64 icospheres (subdivision 2). Unit normals are the same in both scales (spheres only move and scale). Dome look: additive, color (22, 48, 100)%, fresnel-style "fade center" glow (effectModelClass abiMode fadeCenter, abiThickness 97, cullMode none).

fog.order: x fastest, then y, then z (C order [z][y][x][rgba])
fog.note: Story scale only (fades out before the true-scale morph). RGB = emission color (violet 0.55 0.22 0.75 x density), A = 0.55 x density. Density is low-pass noise inside the cone from the CMB (s = 0.14) to just past reionization, with holes where the bubbles are. On the dome the reveal clips it along +x (maxClip) with the shell front. gen_models.gen_fog() rebuilds it.
fog.channel: A of the kit volume: 0.55 x density (0..255)

source.note: Glow sprite at the ray source (dome dotScale 4.5, texture Glow.dds)

flare.note: The Big Bang glow at the apex (dome dotScale 450.0, texture Glow.dds)

cmb.source: Planck 2015 SMICA CMB map (ESA and the Planck Collaboration), north Galactic hemisphere, orthographic; the disc fills 94 % of the square

webb.units: meters (glTF, Y-up as exported by Blender: model +Z (away from the Sun) is glTF +Y; boresight is model +X)

zoom.glide: The cone starts enlarged playZoom x around x = focusX (holder at XC - zoom*focusX) and glides back to scale 1 at the origin from the end of the First-light beat to 4 s into step 5 (ease 6 s in, 10 s out); labels counter-scale 1.25/zoom -> 1.

playAll.finalTurn: 1 s into step 6 the cone turns to this heading over 13 s (ease 4/4)

trueScale.captionDetail: Each white ring is one billion years, and the first stars and galaxies are all in the tip
trueScale.note: True scale: time runs evenly, and the width follows the real expansion of space
trueScale.does: Morph every layer story -> true over 14 s (ease 3/3); fade out bubbles, cards A/B, fog and era labels 1-4; fade in the year rings and their two labels, then the true-scale bubbles, cards and the "first billion years" label 3 s before the end.

Side.title: Instant Nav: the whole cone from the side

Orbit.title: Instant Nav: side view with a slow orbit

LookBack.title: Instant Nav: behind the telescope, looking back

BigBang.title: Instant Nav: near the Big Bang, looking up the cone

style.blending: additive for lines, dots, cards, CMB, bubbles; normal for label cards; the telescope is opaque

drawRangeRule: A reveal advances whole vertices in file order (lines: segments). Rows are written in reveal order and evenly spaced along what the reveal means, so a linear sweep reads as a steady front.
credits: Concept, design and dome build: A. David Weigel, *INTUITIVE*® Planetarium, U.S. Space & Rocket Center.
Cosmology: flat LCDM, Planck 2018 VI (H0 67.4, Omega_m 0.315).
CMB: Planck 2015 SMICA map, ESA and the Planck Collaboration (Planck Legacy Archive).

Galaxy images (nearby galaxies standing in for every epoch): DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10, Pan-STARRS1 Surveys (Chambers et al. 2016), Digitized Sky Survey 2 (STScI; Palomar and UK Schmidt), via CDS hips2fits (Fernique et al. 2015) and the Legacy Surveys viewer.
Reionization bubbles, fog and particles: schematic.

web.cmb: pipeline/cmb_disc.py from the Planck SMICA map, 1024 px JPEG
web.labels: HTML text from cone_labels.json; the PNG cards are not shipped
